119  private static Class<?> safeModeClazz = null;
120  private static Class<?> safeModeActionClazz = null;
121  private static Object safeModeGet = null;
122  {
123    try {
124      safeModeClazz = Class.forName("org.apache.hadoop.fs.SafeMode");
125      safeModeActionClazz = Class.forName("org.apache.hadoop.fs.SafeModeAction");
126      safeModeGet = safeModeClazz.getField("SAFEMODE_GET").get(null);
127    } catch (ClassNotFoundException | NoSuchFieldException e) {
128      LOG.debug("SafeMode interface not in the classpath, this means Hadoop 3.3.5 or below.");
129    } catch (IllegalAccessException e) {
130      LOG.error("SafeModeAction.SAFEMODE_GET is not accessible. "
131        + "Unexpected Hadoop version or messy classpath?", e);
132      throw new RuntimeException(e);
133    }
134  }

139  /** Returns True is <code>fs</code> is instance of DistributedFileSystem n */
140  public static boolean isDistributedFileSystem(final FileSystem fs) throws IOException {
141    FileSystem fileSystem = fs;
142    // If passed an instance of HFileSystem, it fails instanceof DistributedFileSystem.
143    // Check its backing fs for dfs-ness.
144    if (fs instanceof HFileSystem) {
145      fileSystem = ((HFileSystem) fs).getBackingFs();
146    }
147    return fileSystem instanceof DistributedFileSystem;
148  }
149
150  /**
151   * Compare path component of the Path URI; e.g. if hdfs://a/b/c and /a/b/c, it will compare the
152   * '/a/b/c' part. If you passed in 'hdfs://a/b/c and b/c, it would return true. Does not consider
153   * schema; i.e. if schemas different but path or subpath matches, the two will equate.
154   * @param pathToSearch Path we will be trying to match.
155   * @return True if <code>pathTail</code> is tail on the path of <code>pathToSearch</code>
156   */
157  public static boolean isMatchingTail(final Path pathToSearch, final Path pathTail) {
158    Path tailPath = pathTail;
159    String tailName;
160    Path toSearch = pathToSearch;
161    String toSearchName;
162    boolean result = false;
163
164    if (pathToSearch.depth() != pathTail.depth()) {
165      return false;
166    }
167
168    do {
169      tailName = tailPath.getName();
170      if (tailName == null || tailName.isEmpty()) {
171        result = true;
172        break;
173      }
174      toSearchName = toSearch.getName();
175      if (toSearchName == null || toSearchName.isEmpty()) {
176        break;
177      }
178      // Move up a parent on each path for next go around. Path doesn't let us go off the end.
179      tailPath = tailPath.getParent();
180      toSearch = toSearch.getParent();
181    } while (tailName.equals(toSearchName));
182    return result;
183  }

197  /**
198   * Create the specified file on the filesystem. By default, this will:
199   * <ol>
200   * <li>overwrite the file if it exists</li>
201   * <li>apply the umask in the configuration (if it is enabled)</li>
202   * <li>use the fs configured buffer size (or 4096 if not set)</li>
203   * <li>use the configured column family replication or default replication if
204   * {@link ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder#DEFAULT_DFS_REPLICATION}</li>
205   * <li>use the default block size</li>
206   * <li>not track progress</li>
207   * </ol>
208   * @param conf         configurations
209   * @param fs           {@link FileSystem} on which to write the file
210   * @param path         {@link Path} to the file to write
211   * @param perm         permissions
212   * @param favoredNodes favored data nodes
213   * @return output stream to the created file
214   * @throws IOException if the file cannot be created
215   */
216  public static FSDataOutputStream create(Configuration conf, FileSystem fs, Path path,
217    FsPermission perm, InetSocketAddress[] favoredNodes) throws IOException {
218    return create(conf, fs, path, perm, favoredNodes, true);
219  }
220
221  /**
222   * Opens a file for reading. When {@code fileStatus} is supplied and the {@link FileSystem}
223   * supports {@code FileSystem.openFile().withFileStatus()}, that path is used so the client can
224   * skip a redundant metadata lookup (for example {@code getFileInfo}).
225   * @param fs         filesystem
226   * @param path       file to open
227   * @param fileStatus status from a recent {@code listStatus} / {@code getFileStatus}, or
228   *                   {@code null}
229   * @return input stream for the file
230   * @throws IOException if the file cannot be opened
231   */
232  public static FSDataInputStream openForRead(FileSystem fs, Path path, FileStatus fileStatus)
233    throws IOException {
234    if (fileStatus != null) {
235      try {
236        CompletableFuture<FSDataInputStream> future =
237          fs.openFile(path).withFileStatus(fileStatus).build();
238        try {
239          return future.get();
240        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
241          // The open may still complete asynchronously; close whatever stream it produces since
242          // the caller will never receive it. Do not cancel the future, as a cancelled future
243          // would discard a stream that is completed later without closing it.
244          future.whenComplete((in, t) -> IOUtils.cleanupWithLogger(LOG, in));
245          Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
246          throw (InterruptedIOException) new InterruptedIOException("Interrupted opening " + path)
247            .initCause(e);
248        }
249      } catch (UnsupportedOperationException | ExecutionException e) {
250        if (
251          e instanceof ExecutionException
252            && !(e.getCause() instanceof UnsupportedOperationException)
253        ) {
254          Throwable cause = e.getCause();
255          if (cause instanceof IOException) {
256            throw (IOException) cause;
257          }
258          throw new IOException("Failed opening " + path, cause);
259        }
260        if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
261          LOG.debug("openFile().withFileStatus() not supported or failed for {}, "
262            + "fail back with open()", fs.getUri(), e);
263        }
264      }
265    }
266    return fs.open(path);
267  }
268
269  /**
270   * Create the specified file on the filesystem. By default, this will:
271   * <ol>
272   * <li>overwrite the file if it exists</li>
273   * <li>apply the umask in the configuration (if it is enabled)</li>
274   * <li>use the fs configured buffer size (or 4096 if not set)</li>
275   * <li>use the configured column family replication or default replication if
276   * {@link ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder#DEFAULT_DFS_REPLICATION}</li>
277   * <li>use the default block size</li>
278   * <li>not track progress</li>
279   * </ol>
280   * @param conf              configurations
281   * @param fs                {@link FileSystem} on which to write the file
282   * @param path              {@link Path} to the file to write
283   * @param perm              permissions
284   * @param favoredNodes      favored data nodes
285   * @param isRecursiveCreate recursively create parent directories
286   * @return output stream to the created file
287   * @throws IOException if the file cannot be created
288   */
289  public static FSDataOutputStream create(Configuration conf, FileSystem fs, Path path,
290    FsPermission perm, InetSocketAddress[] favoredNodes, boolean isRecursiveCreate)
291    throws IOException {
292    if (fs instanceof HFileSystem) {
293      FileSystem backingFs = ((HFileSystem) fs).getBackingFs();
294      if (backingFs instanceof DistributedFileSystem) {
295        short replication = Short.parseShort(conf.get(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.DFS_REPLICATION,
296          String.valueOf(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.DEFAULT_DFS_REPLICATION)));
297        DistributedFileSystem.HdfsDataOutputStreamBuilder builder =
298          ((DistributedFileSystem) backingFs).createFile(path).recursive().permission(perm)
299            .create();
300        if (favoredNodes != null) {
301          builder.favoredNodes(favoredNodes);
302        }
303        if (replication > 0) {
304          builder.replication(replication);
305        }
306        return builder.build();
307      }
308
309    }
310    return CommonFSUtils.create(fs, path, perm, true, isRecursiveCreate);
311  }

313  /**
314   * Checks to see if the specified file system is available
315   * @param fs filesystem
316   * @throws IOException e
317   */
318  public static void checkFileSystemAvailable(final FileSystem fs) throws IOException {
319    if (!(fs instanceof DistributedFileSystem)) {
320      return;
321    }
322    IOException exception = null;
323    DistributedFileSystem dfs = (DistributedFileSystem) fs;
324    try {
325      if (dfs.exists(new Path("/"))) {
326        return;
327      }
328    } catch (IOException e) {
329      exception = e instanceof RemoteException ? ((RemoteException) e).unwrapRemoteException() : e;
330    }
331    try {
332      fs.close();
333    } catch (Exception e) {
334      LOG.error("file system close failed: ", e);
335    }
336    throw new IOException("File system is not available", exception);
337  }

339  /**
340   * Inquire the Active NameNode's safe mode status.
341   * @param dfs A DistributedFileSystem object representing the underlying HDFS.
342   * @return whether we're in safe mode
343   */
344  private static boolean isInSafeMode(FileSystem dfs) throws IOException {
345    if (isDistributedFileSystem(dfs)) {
346      return ((DistributedFileSystem) dfs).setSafeMode(SAFEMODE_GET, true);
347    } else {
348      try {
349        Object ret = dfs.getClass()
350          .getMethod("setSafeMode", new Class[] { safeModeActionClazz, Boolean.class })
351          .invoke(dfs, safeModeGet, true);
352        return (Boolean) ret;
353      } catch (InvocationTargetException | IllegalAccessException | NoSuchMethodException e) {
354        LOG.error("The file system does not support setSafeMode(). Abort.", e);
355        throw new RuntimeException(e);
356      }
357    }
358  }
359
360  /**
361   * Check whether dfs is in safemode.
362   */
363  public static void checkDfsSafeMode(final Configuration conf) throws IOException {
364    boolean isInSafeMode = false;
365    FileSystem fs = FileSystem.get(conf);
366    if (supportSafeMode(fs)) {
367      isInSafeMode = isInSafeMode(fs);
368    }
369    if (isInSafeMode) {
370      throw new IOException("File system is in safemode, it can't be written now");
371    }
372  }

374  /**
375   * Verifies current version of file system
376   * @param fs      filesystem object
377   * @param rootdir root hbase directory
378   * @return null if no version file exists, version string otherwise
379   * @throws IOException              if the version file fails to open
380   * @throws DeserializationException if the version data cannot be translated into a version
381   */
382  public static String getVersion(FileSystem fs, Path rootdir)
383    throws IOException, DeserializationException {
384    final Path versionFile = new Path(rootdir, HConstants.VERSION_FILE_NAME);
385    FileStatus[] status = null;
386    try {
387      // hadoop 2.0 throws FNFE if directory does not exist.
388      // hadoop 1.0 returns null if directory does not exist.
389      status = fs.listStatus(versionFile);
390    } catch (FileNotFoundException fnfe) {
391      return null;
392    }
393    if (ArrayUtils.getLength(status) == 0) {
394      return null;
395    }
396    String version = null;
397    byte[] content = new byte[(int) status[0].getLen()];
398    FSDataInputStream s = fs.open(versionFile);
399    try {
400      IOUtils.readFully(s, content, 0, content.length);
401      if (ProtobufUtil.isPBMagicPrefix(content)) {
402        version = parseVersionFrom(content);
403      } else {
404        // Presume it pre-pb format.
405        try (DataInputStream dis = new DataInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(content))) {
406          version = dis.readUTF();
407        }
408      }
409    } catch (EOFException eof) {
410      LOG.warn("Version file was empty, odd, will try to set it.");
411    } finally {
412      s.close();
413    }
414    return version;
415  }
416
417  /**
418   * Parse the content of the ${HBASE_ROOTDIR}/hbase.version file.
419   * @param bytes The byte content of the hbase.version file
420   * @return The version found in the file as a String
421   * @throws DeserializationException if the version data cannot be translated into a version
422   */
423  static String parseVersionFrom(final byte[] bytes) throws DeserializationException {
424    ProtobufUtil.expectPBMagicPrefix(bytes);
425    int pblen = ProtobufUtil.lengthOfPBMagic();
426    FSProtos.HBaseVersionFileContent.Builder builder =
427      FSProtos.HBaseVersionFileContent.newBuilder();
428    try {
429      ProtobufUtil.mergeFrom(builder, bytes, pblen, bytes.length - pblen);
430      return builder.getVersion();
431    } catch (IOException e) {
432      // Convert
433      throw new DeserializationException(e);
434    }
435  }
436
437  /**
438   * Create the content to write into the ${HBASE_ROOTDIR}/hbase.version file.
439   * @param version Version to persist
440   * @return Serialized protobuf with <code>version</code> content and a bit of pb magic for a
441   *         prefix.
442   */
443  static byte[] toVersionByteArray(final String version) {
444    FSProtos.HBaseVersionFileContent.Builder builder =
445      FSProtos.HBaseVersionFileContent.newBuilder();
446    return ProtobufUtil.prependPBMagic(builder.setVersion(version).build().toByteArray());
447  }

449  /**
450   * Verifies current version of file system
451   * @param fs      file system
452   * @param rootdir root directory of HBase installation
453   * @param message if true, issues a message on System.out
454   * @throws IOException              if the version file cannot be opened
455   * @throws DeserializationException if the contents of the version file cannot be parsed
456   */
457  public static void checkVersion(FileSystem fs, Path rootdir, boolean message)
458    throws IOException, DeserializationException {
459    checkVersion(fs, rootdir, message, 0, HConstants.DEFAULT_VERSION_FILE_WRITE_ATTEMPTS);
460  }
461
462  /**
463   * Verifies current version of file system
464   * @param fs      file system
465   * @param rootdir root directory of HBase installation
466   * @param message if true, issues a message on System.out
467   * @param wait    wait interval
468   * @param retries number of times to retry
469   * @throws IOException              if the version file cannot be opened
470   * @throws DeserializationException if the contents of the version file cannot be parsed
471   */
472  public static void checkVersion(FileSystem fs, Path rootdir, boolean message, int wait,
473    int retries) throws IOException, DeserializationException {
474    String version = getVersion(fs, rootdir);
475    String msg;
476    if (version == null) {
477      if (!metaRegionExists(fs, rootdir)) {
478        // rootDir is empty (no version file and no root region)
479        // just create new version file (HBASE-1195)
480        setVersion(fs, rootdir, wait, retries);
481        return;
482      } else {
483        msg = "hbase.version file is missing. Is your hbase.rootdir valid? "
484          + "You can restore hbase.version file by running 'HBCK2 filesystem -fix'. "
485          + "See https://github.com/apache/hbase-operator-tools/tree/master/hbase-hbck2";
486      }
487    } else if (version.compareTo(HConstants.FILE_SYSTEM_VERSION) == 0) {
488      return;
489    } else {
490      msg = "HBase file layout needs to be upgraded. Current filesystem version is " + version
491        + " but software requires version " + HConstants.FILE_SYSTEM_VERSION
492        + ". Consult https://hbase.apache.org/docs for further information about "
493        + "upgrading HBase.";
494    }
495
496    // version is deprecated require migration
497    // Output on stdout so user sees it in terminal.
498    if (message) {
499      System.out.println("WARNING! " + msg);
500    }
501    throw new FileSystemVersionException(msg);
502  }

515  /**
516   * Sets version of file system
517   * @param fs      filesystem object
518   * @param rootdir hbase root
519   * @param wait    time to wait for retry
520   * @param retries number of times to retry before failing
521   * @throws IOException e
522   */
523  public static void setVersion(FileSystem fs, Path rootdir, int wait, int retries)
524    throws IOException {
525    setVersion(fs, rootdir, HConstants.FILE_SYSTEM_VERSION, wait, retries);
526  }
527
528  /**
529   * Sets version of file system
530   * @param fs      filesystem object
531   * @param rootdir hbase root directory
532   * @param version version to set
533   * @param wait    time to wait for retry
534   * @param retries number of times to retry before throwing an IOException
535   * @throws IOException e
536   */
537  public static void setVersion(FileSystem fs, Path rootdir, String version, int wait, int retries)
538    throws IOException {
539    Path versionFile = new Path(rootdir, HConstants.VERSION_FILE_NAME);
540    Path tempVersionFile = new Path(rootdir,
541      HConstants.HBASE_TEMP_DIRECTORY + Path.SEPARATOR + HConstants.VERSION_FILE_NAME);
542    while (true) {
543      try {
544        // Write the version to a temporary file
545        FSDataOutputStream s = fs.create(tempVersionFile);
546        try {
547          s.write(toVersionByteArray(version));
548          s.close();
549          s = null;
550          // Move the temp version file to its normal location. Returns false
551          // if the rename failed. Throw an IOE in that case.
552          if (!fs.rename(tempVersionFile, versionFile)) {
553            throw new IOException("Unable to move temp version file to " + versionFile);
554          }
555        } finally {
556          // Cleaning up the temporary if the rename failed would be trying
557          // too hard. We'll unconditionally create it again the next time
558          // through anyway, files are overwritten by default by create().
559
560          // Attempt to close the stream on the way out if it is still open.
561          try {
562            if (s != null) s.close();
563          } catch (IOException ignore) {
564          }
565        }
566        LOG.info("Created version file at " + rootdir.toString() + " with version=" + version);
567        return;
568      } catch (IOException e) {
569        if (retries > 0) {
570          LOG.debug("Unable to create version file at " + rootdir.toString() + ", retrying", e);
571          fs.delete(versionFile, false);
572          try {
573            if (wait > 0) {
574              Thread.sleep(wait);
575            }
576          } catch (InterruptedException ie) {
577            throw (InterruptedIOException) new InterruptedIOException().initCause(ie);
578          }
579          retries--;
580        } else {
581          throw e;
582        }
583      }
584    }
585  }

587  /**
588   * Checks that a cluster ID file exists in the HBase root directory
589   * @param fs      the root directory FileSystem
590   * @param rootdir the HBase root directory in HDFS
591   * @param wait    how long to wait between retries
592   * @return <code>true</code> if the file exists, otherwise <code>false</code>
593   * @throws IOException if checking the FileSystem fails
594   */
595  public static boolean checkFileExistsInHbaseRootDir(FileSystem fs, Path rootdir, String file,
596    long wait) throws IOException {
597    while (true) {
598      try {
599        Path filePath = new Path(rootdir, file);
600        return fs.exists(filePath);
601      } catch (IOException ioe) {
602        if (wait > 0L) {
603          LOG.warn("Unable to check file {} in {}, retrying in {}ms", file, rootdir, wait, ioe);
604          try {
605            Thread.sleep(wait);
606          } catch (InterruptedException e) {
607            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
608            throw (InterruptedIOException) new InterruptedIOException().initCause(e);
609          }
610        } else {
611          throw ioe;
612        }
613      }
614    }
615  }

617  /**
618   * Use the given parser object to read and parse contents of Cluster Id file. e.g. Cluster Id or
619   * Active read-replica Cluster Id
620   */
621  public static <T extends ClusterIdFile> T getClusterIdFile(FileSystem fs, Path rootdir,
622    ClusterIdFileParser<T> parser) throws IOException {
623    Path idPath = new Path(rootdir, parser.getFileName());
624    T cs = null;
625    FileStatus status = fs.exists(idPath) ? fs.getFileStatus(idPath) : null;
626    if (status != null) {
627      int len = Ints.checkedCast(status.getLen());
628      byte[] content = new byte[len];
629      FSDataInputStream in = fs.open(idPath);
630      try {
631        in.readFully(content);
632      } catch (EOFException eof) {
633        LOG.warn("Cluster file {} is empty", idPath);
634      } finally {
635        in.close();
636      }
637      try {
638        cs = parser.parseFrom(content);
639      } catch (DeserializationException e) {
640        throw new IOException("content=" + Bytes.toString(content), e);
641      }
642      // If not pb'd, make it so.
643      if (!ProtobufUtil.isPBMagicPrefix(content)) {
644        String cid = null;
645        in = fs.open(idPath);
646        try {
647          cid = in.readUTF();
648          cs = parser.readString(cid);
649        } catch (EOFException eof) {
650          LOG.warn("Cluster file {} is empty", idPath);
651        } finally {
652          in.close();
653        }
654        rewriteAsPb(fs, rootdir, idPath, parser.getFileName(), cs);
655      }
656      return cs;
657    } else {
658      LOG.warn("Cluster file does not exist at {}", idPath);
659    }
660    return cs;
661  }

677  private static <T extends ClusterIdFile> void rewriteAsPb(final FileSystem fs, final Path rootdir,
678    final Path p, final String fileName, final T cs) throws IOException {
679    // Rewrite the file as pb. Move aside the old one first, write new
680    // then delete the moved-aside file.
681    Path movedAsideName = new Path(p + "." + EnvironmentEdgeManager.currentTime());
682    if (!fs.rename(p, movedAsideName)) throw new IOException("Failed rename of " + p);
683    setClusterIdFile(fs, rootdir, fileName, cs, 100);
684    if (!fs.delete(movedAsideName, false)) {
685      throw new IOException("Failed delete of " + movedAsideName);
686    }
687    LOG.debug("Rewrote the {} file as pb", fileName);
688  }

690  /**
691   * Writes a new unique identifier for this cluster to the Cluster Id ("hbase.id" or
692   * "active.cluster.suffix.id") file in the HBase root directory. If any operations on the ID file
693   * fails, and {@code wait} is a positive value, the method will retry to produce the ID file until
694   * the thread is forcibly interrupted.
695   * @param fs       the root directory FileSystem
696   * @param rootdir  the path to the HBase root directory
697   * @param fileName name of the file to be written
698   * @param cs       the object to be written
699   * @param wait     how long (in milliseconds) to wait between retries
700   * @throws IOException if writing to the FileSystem fails and no wait value
701   */
702  public static <T extends ClusterIdFile> void setClusterIdFile(final FileSystem fs,
703    final Path rootdir, final String fileName, final T cs, final long wait) throws IOException {
704    final Path idFile = new Path(rootdir, fileName);
705    final Path tempDir = new Path(rootdir, HConstants.HBASE_TEMP_DIRECTORY);
706    final Path tempIdFile = new Path(tempDir, fileName);
707
708    LOG.debug("Cluster file [{}] is present and contains cluster id: {}", idFile, cs);
709    writeClusterInfo(fs, rootdir, idFile, tempIdFile, cs.toByteArray(), wait);
710  }
711
712  /**
713   * Writes information about this cluster to the specified file. For ex, it is used for writing
714   * cluster id in "hbase.id" file in the HBase root directory. Also, used for writing active
715   * cluster suffix in "active_cluster_suffix.id" file. If any operations on the ID file fails, and
716   * {@code wait} is a positive value, the method will retry to produce the ID file until the thread
717   * is forcibly interrupted.
718   */
719  private static void writeClusterInfo(final FileSystem fs, final Path rootdir, final Path idFile,
720    final Path tempIdFile, byte[] fileData, final long wait) throws IOException {
721    while (true) {
722      Optional<IOException> failure = Optional.empty();
723
724      LOG.debug("Write the file to a temporary location: {}", tempIdFile);
725      try (FSDataOutputStream s = fs.create(tempIdFile)) {
726        s.write(fileData);
727      } catch (IOException ioe) {
728        failure = Optional.of(ioe);
729      }
730
731      if (!failure.isPresent()) {
732        try {
733          LOG.debug("Move the temporary file to its target location [{}]:[{}]", tempIdFile, idFile);
734
735          if (!fs.rename(tempIdFile, idFile)) {
736            failure = Optional.of(new IOException("Unable to move temp file to " + idFile));
737          }
738        } catch (IOException ioe) {
739          failure = Optional.of(ioe);
740        }
741      }
742
743      if (failure.isPresent()) {
744        final IOException cause = failure.get();
745        if (wait > 0L) {
746          LOG.warn("Unable to create file in {}, retrying in {}ms", rootdir, wait, cause);
747          try {
748            Thread.sleep(wait);
749          } catch (InterruptedException e) {
750            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
751            throw (InterruptedIOException) new InterruptedIOException().initCause(e);
752          }
753          continue;
754        } else {
755          throw cause;
756        }
757      } else {
758        return;
759      }
760    }
761  }
762
763  /**
764   * If DFS, check safe mode and if so, wait until we clear it.
765   * @param conf configuration
766   * @param wait Sleep between retries
767   * @throws IOException e
768   */
769  public static void waitOnSafeMode(final Configuration conf, final long wait) throws IOException {
770    FileSystem fs = FileSystem.get(conf);
771    if (!supportSafeMode(fs)) {
772      return;
773    }
774    // Make sure dfs is not in safe mode
775    while (isInSafeMode(fs)) {
776      LOG.info("Waiting for dfs to exit safe mode...");
777      try {
778        Thread.sleep(wait);
779      } catch (InterruptedException e) {
780        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
781        throw (InterruptedIOException) new InterruptedIOException().initCause(e);
782      }
783    }
784  }
785
786  public static boolean supportSafeMode(FileSystem fs) {
787    // return true if HDFS.
788    if (fs instanceof DistributedFileSystem) {
789      return true;
790    }
791    // return true if the file system implements SafeMode interface.
792    if (safeModeClazz != null) {
793      return (safeModeClazz.isAssignableFrom(fs.getClass()));
794    }
795    // return false if the file system is not HDFS and does not implement SafeMode interface.
796    return false;
797  }

810  /**
811   * Compute HDFS block distribution of a given HdfsDataInputStream. All HdfsDataInputStreams are
812   * backed by a series of LocatedBlocks, which are fetched periodically from the namenode. This
813   * method retrieves those blocks from the input stream and uses them to calculate
814   * HDFSBlockDistribution. The underlying method in DFSInputStream does attempt to use locally
815   * cached blocks, but may hit the namenode if the cache is determined to be incomplete. The method
816   * also involves making copies of all LocatedBlocks rather than return the underlying blocks
817   * themselves.
818   */
819  static public HDFSBlocksDistribution
820    computeHDFSBlocksDistribution(HdfsDataInputStream inputStream) throws IOException {
821    List<LocatedBlock> blocks = inputStream.getAllBlocks();
822    HDFSBlocksDistribution blocksDistribution = new HDFSBlocksDistribution();
823    for (LocatedBlock block : blocks) {
824      String[] hosts = getHostsForLocations(block);
825      long len = block.getBlockSize();
826      StorageType[] storageTypes = block.getStorageTypes();
827      blocksDistribution.addHostsAndBlockWeight(hosts, len, storageTypes);
828    }
829    return blocksDistribution;
830  }
831
832  private static String[] getHostsForLocations(LocatedBlock block) {
833    DatanodeInfo[] locations = getLocatedBlockLocations(block);
834    String[] hosts = new String[locations.length];
835    for (int i = 0; i < hosts.length; i++) {
836      hosts[i] = locations[i].getHostName();
837    }
838    return hosts;
839  }
840
841  /**
842   * Compute HDFS blocks distribution of a given file, or a portion of the file
843   * @param fs     file system
844   * @param status file status of the file
845   * @param start  start position of the portion
846   * @param length length of the portion
847   * @return The HDFS blocks distribution
848   */
849  static public HDFSBlocksDistribution computeHDFSBlocksDistribution(final FileSystem fs,
850    FileStatus status, long start, long length) throws IOException {
851    HDFSBlocksDistribution blocksDistribution = new HDFSBlocksDistribution();
852    BlockLocation[] blockLocations = fs.getFileBlockLocations(status, start, length);
853    addToHDFSBlocksDistribution(blocksDistribution, blockLocations);
854    return blocksDistribution;
855  }
856
857  /**
858   * Update blocksDistribution with blockLocations
859   * @param blocksDistribution the hdfs blocks distribution
860   * @param blockLocations     an array containing block location
861   */
862  static public void addToHDFSBlocksDistribution(HDFSBlocksDistribution blocksDistribution,
863    BlockLocation[] blockLocations) throws IOException {
864    for (BlockLocation bl : blockLocations) {
865      String[] hosts = bl.getHosts();
866      long len = bl.getLength();
867      StorageType[] storageTypes = bl.getStorageTypes();
868      blocksDistribution.addHostsAndBlockWeight(hosts, len, storageTypes);
869    }
870  }

873  /**
874   * Returns the total overall fragmentation percentage. Includes hbase:meta and -ROOT- as well.
875   * @param master The master defining the HBase root and file system
876   * @return A map for each table and its percentage (never null)
877   * @throws IOException When scanning the directory fails
878   */
879  public static int getTotalTableFragmentation(final HMaster master) throws IOException {
880    Map<String, Integer> map = getTableFragmentation(master);
881    return map.isEmpty() ? -1 : map.get("-TOTAL-");
882  }

884  /**
885   * Runs through the HBase rootdir and checks how many stores for each table have more than one
886   * file in them. Checks -ROOT- and hbase:meta too. The total percentage across all tables is
887   * stored under the special key "-TOTAL-".
888   * @param master The master defining the HBase root and file system.
889   * @return A map for each table and its percentage (never null).
890   * @throws IOException When scanning the directory fails.
891   */
892  public static Map<String, Integer> getTableFragmentation(final HMaster master)
893    throws IOException {
894    Path path = CommonFSUtils.getRootDir(master.getConfiguration());
895    // since HMaster.getFileSystem() is package private
896    FileSystem fs = path.getFileSystem(master.getConfiguration());
897    return getTableFragmentation(fs, path);
898  }
899
900  /**
901   * Runs through the HBase rootdir and checks how many stores for each table have more than one
902   * file in them. Checks -ROOT- and hbase:meta too. The total percentage across all tables is
903   * stored under the special key "-TOTAL-".
904   * @param fs           The file system to use
905   * @param hbaseRootDir The root directory to scan
906   * @return A map for each table and its percentage (never null)
907   * @throws IOException When scanning the directory fails
908   */
909  public static Map<String, Integer> getTableFragmentation(final FileSystem fs,
910    final Path hbaseRootDir) throws IOException {
911    Map<String, Integer> frags = new HashMap<>();
912    int cfCountTotal = 0;
913    int cfFragTotal = 0;
914    PathFilter regionFilter = new RegionDirFilter(fs);
915    PathFilter familyFilter = new FamilyDirFilter(fs);
916    List<Path> tableDirs = getTableDirs(fs, hbaseRootDir);
917    for (Path d : tableDirs) {
918      int cfCount = 0;
919      int cfFrag = 0;
920      FileStatus[] regionDirs = fs.listStatus(d, regionFilter);
921      for (FileStatus regionDir : regionDirs) {
922        Path dd = regionDir.getPath();
923        // else its a region name, now look in region for families
924        FileStatus[] familyDirs = fs.listStatus(dd, familyFilter);
925        for (FileStatus familyDir : familyDirs) {
926          cfCount++;
927          cfCountTotal++;
928          Path family = familyDir.getPath();
929          // now in family make sure only one file
930          FileStatus[] familyStatus = fs.listStatus(family);
931          if (familyStatus.length > 1) {
932            cfFrag++;
933            cfFragTotal++;
934          }
935        }
936      }
937      // compute percentage per table and store in result list
938      frags.put(CommonFSUtils.getTableName(d).getNameAsString(),
939        cfCount == 0 ? 0 : Math.round((float) cfFrag / cfCount * 100));
940    }
941    // set overall percentage for all tables
942    frags.put("-TOTAL-",
943      cfCountTotal == 0 ? 0 : Math.round((float) cfFragTotal / cfCountTotal * 100));
944    return frags;
945  }

947  public static void renameFile(FileSystem fs, Path src, Path dst) throws IOException {
948    if (fs.exists(dst) && !fs.delete(dst, false)) {
949      throw new IOException("Can not delete " + dst);
950    }
951    if (!fs.rename(src, dst)) {
952      throw new IOException("Can not rename from " + src + " to " + dst);
953    }
954  }

977  /**
978   * Directory filter that doesn't include any of the directories in the specified blacklist
979   */
980  public static class BlackListDirFilter extends AbstractFileStatusFilter {
981    private final FileSystem fs;
982    private List<String> blacklist;
983
984    /**
985     * Create a filter on the givem filesystem with the specified blacklist
986     * @param fs                     filesystem to filter
987     * @param directoryNameBlackList list of the names of the directories to filter. If
988     *                               <tt>null</tt>, all directories are returned
989     */
990    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
991    public BlackListDirFilter(final FileSystem fs, final List<String> directoryNameBlackList) {
992      this.fs = fs;
993      blacklist = (List<String>) (directoryNameBlackList == null
994        ? Collections.emptyList()
995        : directoryNameBlackList);
996    }
997
998    @Override
999    protected boolean accept(Path p, @CheckForNull Boolean isDir) {
1000      if (!isValidName(p.getName())) {
1001        return false;
1002      }
1003
1004      try {
1005        return isDirectory(fs, isDir, p);
1006      } catch (IOException e) {
1007        LOG.warn("An error occurred while verifying if [{}] is a valid directory."
1008          + " Returning 'not valid' and continuing.", p, e);
1009        return false;
1010      }
1011    }
1012
1013    protected boolean isValidName(final String name) {
1014      return !blacklist.contains(name);
1015    }
1016  }

1028  /**
1029   * A {@link PathFilter} that returns usertable directories. To get all directories use the
1030   * {@link BlackListDirFilter} with a <tt>null</tt> blacklist
1031   */
1032  public static class UserTableDirFilter extends BlackListDirFilter {
1033    public UserTableDirFilter(FileSystem fs) {
1034      super(fs, HConstants.HBASE_NON_TABLE_DIRS);
1035    }
1036
1037    @Override
1038    protected boolean isValidName(final String name) {
1039      if (!super.isValidName(name)) return false;
1040
1041      try {
1042        TableName.isLegalTableQualifierName(Bytes.toBytes(name));
1043      } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
1044        LOG.info("Invalid table name: {}", name);
1045        return false;
1046      }
1047      return true;
1048    }
1049  }

1051  public static List<Path> getTableDirs(final FileSystem fs, final Path rootdir)
1052    throws IOException {
1053    List<Path> tableDirs = new ArrayList<>();
1054    Path baseNamespaceDir = new Path(rootdir, HConstants.BASE_NAMESPACE_DIR);
1055    if (fs.exists(baseNamespaceDir)) {
1056      for (FileStatus status : fs.globStatus(new Path(baseNamespaceDir, "*"))) {
1057        tableDirs.addAll(FSUtils.getLocalTableDirs(fs, status.getPath()));
1058      }
1059    }
1060    return tableDirs;
1061  }

1063  /**
1064   * @return All the table directories under <code>rootdir</code>. Ignore non table hbase folders
1065   *         such as .logs, .oldlogs, .corrupt folders.
1066   */
1067  public static List<Path> getLocalTableDirs(final FileSystem fs, final Path rootdir)
1068    throws IOException {
1069    // presumes any directory under hbase.rootdir is a table
1070    FileStatus[] dirs = fs.listStatus(rootdir, new UserTableDirFilter(fs));
1071    List<Path> tabledirs = new ArrayList<>(dirs.length);
1072    for (FileStatus dir : dirs) {
1073      tabledirs.add(dir.getPath());
1074    }
1075    return tabledirs;
1076  }

1078  /**
1079   * A filter to exclude meta tables belonging to foreign clusters. This is essential in a
1080   * read-replica setup where multiple clusters share the same fs.
1081   * @param tablePath The Path to the table directory.
1082   * @return {@code true} if the path is a regular table or the cluster's own meta table.
1083   *         {@code false} if it is a meta table belonging to a different cluster.
1084   */
1085  public static boolean isLocalMetaTable(Path tablePath) {
1086    if (tablePath == null) {
1087      return false;
1088    }
1089    String dirName = tablePath.getName();
1090    if (dirName.startsWith(TableName.META_TABLE_NAME.getQualifierAsString())) {
1091      return TableName.valueOf(TableName.META_TABLE_NAME.getNamespaceAsString(), dirName)
1092        .equals(TableName.META_TABLE_NAME);
1093    }
1094    return true;
1095  }

1097  /**
1098   * Filter for all dirs that don't start with '.'
1099   */
1100  public static class RegionDirFilter extends AbstractFileStatusFilter {
1101    // This pattern will accept 0.90+ style hex region dirs and older numeric region dir names.
1102    final public static Pattern regionDirPattern = Pattern.compile("^[0-9a-f]*$");
1103    final FileSystem fs;
1104
1105    public RegionDirFilter(FileSystem fs) {
1106      this.fs = fs;
1107    }
1108
1109    @Override
1110    protected boolean accept(Path p, @CheckForNull Boolean isDir) {
1111      if (!regionDirPattern.matcher(p.getName()).matches()) {
1112        return false;
1113      }
1114
1115      try {
1116        return isDirectory(fs, isDir, p);
1117      } catch (IOException ioe) {
1118        // Maybe the file was moved or the fs was disconnected.
1119        LOG.warn("Skipping file {} due to IOException", p, ioe);
1120        return false;
1121      }
1122    }
1123  }

1142      regionDirs.add(rdPath);
1143    }
1144    return regionDirs;
1145  }

1228        result += getReferenceAndLinkFilePaths(fs, familyDir).size();

1236  public static class ReferenceAndLinkFileFilter implements PathFilter {
1237
1238    private final FileSystem fs;
1239
1240    public ReferenceAndLinkFileFilter(FileSystem fs) {
1241      this.fs = fs;
1242    }
1243
1244    @Override
1245    public boolean accept(Path rd) {
1246      try {
1247        // only files can be references.
1248        return !fs.getFileStatus(rd).isDirectory()
1249          && (StoreFileInfo.isReference(rd) || HFileLink.isHFileLink(rd));
1250      } catch (IOException ioe) {
1251        // Maybe the file was moved or the fs was disconnected.
1252        LOG.warn("Skipping file " + rd + " due to IOException", ioe);
1253        return false;
1254      }
1255    }
1256  }

1258  /**
1259   * Filter for HFiles that excludes reference files.
1260   */
1261  public static class HFileFilter extends AbstractFileStatusFilter {
1262    final FileSystem fs;
1263
1264    public HFileFilter(FileSystem fs) {
1265      this.fs = fs;
1266    }
1267
1268    @Override
1269    protected boolean accept(Path p, @CheckForNull Boolean isDir) {
1270      if (!StoreFileInfo.isHFile(p) && !StoreFileInfo.isMobFile(p)) {
1271        return false;
1272      }
1273
1274      try {
1275        return isFile(fs, isDir, p);
1276      } catch (IOException ioe) {
1277        // Maybe the file was moved or the fs was disconnected.
1278        LOG.warn("Skipping file {} due to IOException", p, ioe);
1279        return false;
1280      }
1281    }
1282  }

1367   * @param executor         optional executor service to parallelize this operation
1368   * @param progressReporter Instance or null; gets called every time we move to new region of
1369   *                         family dir and for each store file.
1370   * @return Map keyed by StoreFile name with a value of the full Path.
1371   * @throws IOException When scanning the directory fails.
1372   * @deprecated Since 2.3.0. For removal in hbase4. Use ProgressReporter override instead.
1373   */
1374  @Deprecated
1375  public static Map<String, Path> getTableStoreFilePathMap(Map<String, Path> resultMap,
1376    final FileSystem fs, final Path hbaseRootDir, TableName tableName, final PathFilter sfFilter,
1377    ExecutorService executor, final HbckErrorReporter progressReporter)

1380      new ProgressReporter() {

1389  /**
1390   * Runs through the HBase rootdir/tablename and creates a reverse lookup map for table StoreFile
1391   * names to the full Path. Note that because this method can be called on a 'live' HBase system
1392   * that we will skip files that no longer exist by the time we traverse them and similarly the
1393   * user of the result needs to consider that some entries in this map may not exist by the time
1394   * this call completes. <br>
1395   * Example...<br>
1396   * Key = 3944417774205889744 <br>
1397   * Value = hdfs://localhost:51169/user/userid/-ROOT-/70236052/info/3944417774205889744
1398   * @param resultMap        map to add values. If null, this method will create and populate one to
1399   *                         return
1400   * @param fs               The file system to use.
1401   * @param hbaseRootDir     The root directory to scan.
1402   * @param tableName        name of the table to scan.
1403   * @param sfFilter         optional path filter to apply to store files
1404   * @param executor         optional executor service to parallelize this operation
1405   * @param progressReporter Instance or null; gets called every time we move to new region of
1406   *                         family dir and for each store file.
1407   * @return Map keyed by StoreFile name with a value of the full Path.
1408   * @throws IOException          When scanning the directory fails.
1409   * @throws InterruptedException the thread is interrupted, either before or during the activity.
1410   */
1411  public static Map<String, Path> getTableStoreFilePathMap(Map<String, Path> resultMap,
1412    final FileSystem fs, final Path hbaseRootDir, TableName tableName, final PathFilter sfFilter,
1413    ExecutorService executor, final ProgressReporter progressReporter)
1414    throws IOException, InterruptedException {
1415
1416    final Map<String, Path> finalResultMap =
1417      resultMap == null ? new ConcurrentHashMap<>(128, 0.75f, 32) : resultMap;
1418
1419    // only include the directory paths to tables
1420    Path tableDir = CommonFSUtils.getTableDir(hbaseRootDir, tableName);
1421    // Inside a table, there are compaction.dir directories to skip. Otherwise, all else
1422    // should be regions.
1423    final FamilyDirFilter familyFilter = new FamilyDirFilter(fs);
1424    final Vector<Exception> exceptions = new Vector<>();
1425
1426    try {
1427      List<FileStatus> regionDirs =
1428        FSUtils.listStatusWithStatusFilter(fs, tableDir, new RegionDirFilter(fs));
1429      if (regionDirs == null) {
1430        return finalResultMap;
1431      }
1432
1433      final List<Future<?>> futures = new ArrayList<>(regionDirs.size());
1434
1435      for (FileStatus regionDir : regionDirs) {
1436        if (null != progressReporter) {
1437          progressReporter.progress(regionDir);
1438        }
1439        final Path dd = regionDir.getPath();
1440
1441        if (!exceptions.isEmpty()) {
1442          break;
1443        }
1444
1445        Runnable getRegionStoreFileMapCall = new Runnable() {
1446          @Override
1447          public void run() {
1448            try {
1449              HashMap<String, Path> regionStoreFileMap = new HashMap<>();
1450              List<FileStatus> familyDirs =
1451                FSUtils.listStatusWithStatusFilter(fs, dd, familyFilter);
1452              if (familyDirs == null) {
1453                if (!fs.exists(dd)) {
1454                  LOG.warn("Skipping region because it no longer exists: " + dd);
1455                } else {
1456                  LOG.warn("Skipping region because it has no family dirs: " + dd);
1457                }
1458                return;
1459              }
1460              for (FileStatus familyDir : familyDirs) {
1461                if (null != progressReporter) {
1462                  progressReporter.progress(familyDir);
1463                }
1464                Path family = familyDir.getPath();
1465                if (family.getName().equals(HConstants.RECOVERED_EDITS_DIR)) {
1466                  continue;
1467                }
1468                // now in family, iterate over the StoreFiles and
1469                // put in map
1470                FileStatus[] familyStatus = fs.listStatus(family);
1471                for (FileStatus sfStatus : familyStatus) {
1472                  if (null != progressReporter) {
1473                    progressReporter.progress(sfStatus);
1474                  }
1475                  Path sf = sfStatus.getPath();
1476                  if (sfFilter == null || sfFilter.accept(sf)) {
1477                    regionStoreFileMap.put(sf.getName(), sf);
1478                  }
1479                }
1480              }
1481              finalResultMap.putAll(regionStoreFileMap);
1482            } catch (Exception e) {
1483              LOG.error("Could not get region store file map for region: " + dd, e);
1484              exceptions.add(e);
1485            }
1486          }
1487        };
1488
1489        // If executor is available, submit async tasks to exec concurrently, otherwise
1490        // just do serial sync execution
1491        if (executor != null) {
1492          Future<?> future = executor.submit(getRegionStoreFileMapCall);
1493          futures.add(future);
1494        } else {
1495          FutureTask<?> future = new FutureTask<>(getRegionStoreFileMapCall, null);
1496          future.run();
1497          futures.add(future);
1498        }
1499      }
1500
1501      // Ensure all pending tasks are complete (or that we run into an exception)
1502      for (Future<?> f : futures) {
1503        if (!exceptions.isEmpty()) {
1504          break;
1505        }
1506        try {
1507          f.get();
1508        } catch (ExecutionException e) {
1509          LOG.error("Unexpected exec exception!  Should've been caught already.  (Bug?)", e);
1510          // Shouldn't happen, we already logged/caught any exceptions in the Runnable
1511        }
1512      }
1513    } catch (IOException e) {
1514      LOG.error("Cannot execute getTableStoreFilePathMap for " + tableName, e);
1515      exceptions.add(e);
1516    } finally {
1517      if (!exceptions.isEmpty()) {
1518        // Just throw the first exception as an indication something bad happened
1519        // Don't need to propagate all the exceptions, we already logged them all anyway
1520        Throwables.propagateIfPossible(exceptions.firstElement(), IOException.class);
1521        throw new IOException(exceptions.firstElement());
1522      }
1523    }
1524
1525    return finalResultMap;
1526  }
1527
1528  public static int getRegionReferenceFileCount(final FileSystem fs, final Path p) {
1529    int result = 0;
1530    try {
1531      for (Path familyDir : getFamilyDirs(fs, p)) {
1532        result += getReferenceFilePaths(fs, familyDir).size();
1533      }
1534    } catch (IOException e) {
1535      LOG.warn("Error counting reference files", e);
1536    }
1537    return result;
1538  }

1617  /**
1618   * Filters FileStatuses in an array and returns a list
1619   * @param input  An array of FileStatuses
1620   * @param filter A required filter to filter the array
1621   * @return A list of FileStatuses
1622   */
1623  public static List<FileStatus> filterFileStatuses(FileStatus[] input, FileStatusFilter filter) {
1624    if (input == null) return null;
1625    return filterFileStatuses(Iterators.forArray(input), filter);
1626  }
1627
1628  /**
1629   * Filters FileStatuses in an iterator and returns a list
1630   * @param input  An iterator of FileStatuses
1631   * @param filter A required filter to filter the array
1632   * @return A list of FileStatuses
1633   */
1634  public static List<FileStatus> filterFileStatuses(Iterator<FileStatus> input,
1635    FileStatusFilter filter) {
1636    if (input == null) return null;
1637    ArrayList<FileStatus> results = new ArrayList<>();
1638    while (input.hasNext()) {
1639      FileStatus f = input.next();
1640      if (filter.accept(f)) {
1641        results.add(f);
1642      }
1643    }
1644    return results;
1645  }

1647  /**
1648   * Calls fs.listStatus() and treats FileNotFoundException as non-fatal This accommodates
1649   * differences between hadoop versions, where hadoop 1 does not throw a FileNotFoundException, and
1650   * return an empty FileStatus[] while Hadoop 2 will throw FileNotFoundException.
1651   * @param fs     file system
1652   * @param dir    directory
1653   * @param filter file status filter
1654   * @return null if dir is empty or doesn't exist, otherwise FileStatus list
1655   */
1656  public static List<FileStatus> listStatusWithStatusFilter(final FileSystem fs, final Path dir,
1657    final FileStatusFilter filter) throws IOException {
1658    FileStatus[] status = null;
1659    try {
1660      status = fs.listStatus(dir);
1661    } catch (FileNotFoundException fnfe) {
1662      LOG.trace("{} does not exist", dir);
1663      return null;
1664    }
1665
1666    if (ArrayUtils.getLength(status) == 0) {
1667      return null;
1668    }
1669
1670    if (filter == null) {
1671      return Arrays.asList(status);
1672    } else {
1673      List<FileStatus> status2 = filterFileStatuses(status, filter);
1674      if (status2 == null || status2.isEmpty()) {
1675        return null;
1676      } else {
1677        return status2;
1678      }
1679    }
1680  }

1682  /**
1683   * This function is to scan the root path of the file system to get the degree of locality for
1684   * each region on each of the servers having at least one block of that region. This is used by
1685   * the tool {@link org.apache.hadoop.hbase.master.RegionPlacementMaintainer} the configuration to
1686   * use
1687   * @return the mapping from region encoded name to a map of server names to locality fraction in
1688   *         case of file system errors or interrupts
1689   */
1690  public static Map<String, Map<String, Float>>
1691    getRegionDegreeLocalityMappingFromFS(final Configuration conf) throws IOException {
1692    return getRegionDegreeLocalityMappingFromFS(conf, null,
1693      conf.getInt(THREAD_POOLSIZE, DEFAULT_THREAD_POOLSIZE));
1694
1695  }
1696
1697  /**
1698   * This function is to scan the root path of the file system to get the degree of locality for
1699   * each region on each of the servers having at least one block of that region. the configuration
1700   * to use the table you wish to scan locality for the thread pool size to use
1701   * @return the mapping from region encoded name to a map of server names to locality fraction in
1702   *         case of file system errors or interrupts
1703   */
1704  public static Map<String, Map<String, Float>> getRegionDegreeLocalityMappingFromFS(
1705    final Configuration conf, final String desiredTable, int threadPoolSize) throws IOException {
1706    Map<String, Map<String, Float>> regionDegreeLocalityMapping = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
1707    getRegionLocalityMappingFromFS(conf, desiredTable, threadPoolSize, regionDegreeLocalityMapping);
1708    return regionDegreeLocalityMapping;
1709  }
1710
1711  /**
1712   * This function is to scan the root path of the file system to get either the mapping between the
1713   * region name and its best locality region server or the degree of locality of each region on
1714   * each of the servers having at least one block of that region. The output map parameters are
1715   * both optional. the configuration to use the table you wish to scan locality for the thread pool
1716   * size to use the map into which to put the locality degree mapping or null, must be a
1717   * thread-safe implementation in case of file system errors or interrupts
1718   */
1719  private static void getRegionLocalityMappingFromFS(final Configuration conf,
1720    final String desiredTable, int threadPoolSize,
1721    final Map<String, Map<String, Float>> regionDegreeLocalityMapping) throws IOException {
1722    final FileSystem fs = FileSystem.get(conf);
1723    final Path rootPath = CommonFSUtils.getRootDir(conf);
1724    final long startTime = EnvironmentEdgeManager.currentTime();
1725    final Path queryPath;
1726    // The table files are in ${hbase.rootdir}/data/<namespace>/<table>/*
1727    if (null == desiredTable) {
1728      queryPath =
1729        new Path(new Path(rootPath, HConstants.BASE_NAMESPACE_DIR).toString() + "/*/*/*/");
1730    } else {
1731      queryPath = new Path(
1732        CommonFSUtils.getTableDir(rootPath, TableName.valueOf(desiredTable)).toString() + "/*/");
1733    }
1734
1735    // reject all paths that are not appropriate
1736    PathFilter pathFilter = new PathFilter() {
1737      @Override
1738      public boolean accept(Path path) {
1739        // this is the region name; it may get some noise data
1740        if (null == path) {
1741          return false;
1742        }
1743
1744        // no parent?
1745        Path parent = path.getParent();
1746        if (null == parent) {
1747          return false;
1748        }
1749
1750        String regionName = path.getName();
1751        if (null == regionName) {
1752          return false;
1753        }
1754
1755        if (!regionName.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).matches("[0-9a-f]+")) {
1756          return false;
1757        }
1758        return true;
1759      }
1760    };
1761
1762    FileStatus[] statusList = fs.globStatus(queryPath, pathFilter);
1763
1764    if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
1765      LOG.debug("Query Path: {} ; # list of files: {}", queryPath, Arrays.toString(statusList));
1766    }
1767
1768    if (null == statusList) {
1769      return;
1770    }
1771
1772    // lower the number of threads in case we have very few expected regions
1773    threadPoolSize = Math.min(threadPoolSize, statusList.length);
1774
1775    // run in multiple threads
1776    final ExecutorService tpe = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(threadPoolSize,
1777      new ThreadFactoryBuilder().setNameFormat("FSRegionQuery-pool-%d").setDaemon(true)
1778        .setUncaughtExceptionHandler(Threads.LOGGING_EXCEPTION_HANDLER).build());
1779    try {
1780      // ignore all file status items that are not of interest
1781      for (FileStatus regionStatus : statusList) {
1782        if (null == regionStatus || !regionStatus.isDirectory()) {
1783          continue;
1784        }
1785
1786        final Path regionPath = regionStatus.getPath();
1787        if (null != regionPath) {
1788          tpe.execute(new FSRegionScanner(fs, regionPath, null, regionDegreeLocalityMapping));
1789        }
1790      }
1791    } finally {
1792      tpe.shutdown();
1793      final long threadWakeFrequency = (long) conf.getInt(HConstants.THREAD_WAKE_FREQUENCY,
1794        HConstants.DEFAULT_THREAD_WAKE_FREQUENCY);
1795      try {
1796        // here we wait until TPE terminates, which is either naturally or by
1797        // exceptions in the execution of the threads
1798        while (!tpe.awaitTermination(threadWakeFrequency, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)) {
1799          // printing out rough estimate, so as to not introduce
1800          // AtomicInteger
1801          LOG.info("Locality checking is underway: { Scanned Regions : "
1802            + ((ThreadPoolExecutor) tpe).getCompletedTaskCount() + "/"
1803            + ((ThreadPoolExecutor) tpe).getTaskCount() + " }");
1804        }
1805      } catch (InterruptedException e) {
1806        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
1807        throw (InterruptedIOException) new InterruptedIOException().initCause(e);
1808      }
1809    }
1810
1811    long overhead = EnvironmentEdgeManager.currentTime() - startTime;
1812    LOG.info("Scan DFS for locality info takes {}ms", overhead);
1813  }
1814
1815  /**
1816   * Do our short circuit read setup. Checks buffer size to use and whether to do checksumming in
1817   * hbase or hdfs.
1818   */
1819  public static void setupShortCircuitRead(final Configuration conf) {
1820    // Check that the user has not set the "dfs.client.read.shortcircuit.skip.checksum" property.
1821    boolean shortCircuitSkipChecksum =
1822      conf.getBoolean("dfs.client.read.shortcircuit.skip.checksum", false);
1823    boolean useHBaseChecksum = conf.getBoolean(HConstants.HBASE_CHECKSUM_VERIFICATION, true);
1824    if (shortCircuitSkipChecksum) {
1825      LOG.warn("Configuration \"dfs.client.read.shortcircuit.skip.checksum\" should not "
1826        + "be set to true."
1827        + (useHBaseChecksum
1828          ? " HBase checksum doesn't require "
1829            + "it, see https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/HBASE-6868."
1830          : ""));
1831      assert !shortCircuitSkipChecksum; // this will fail if assertions are on
1832    }
1833    checkShortCircuitReadBufferSize(conf);
1834  }
1835
1836  /**
1837   * Check if short circuit read buffer size is set and if not, set it to hbase value.
1838   */
1839  public static void checkShortCircuitReadBufferSize(final Configuration conf) {
1840    final int defaultSize = HConstants.DEFAULT_BLOCKSIZE * 2;
1841    final int notSet = -1;
1842    // DFSConfigKeys.DFS_CLIENT_READ_SHORTCIRCUIT_BUFFER_SIZE_KEY is only defined in h2
1843    final String dfsKey = "dfs.client.read.shortcircuit.buffer.size";
1844    int size = conf.getInt(dfsKey, notSet);
1845    // If a size is set, return -- we will use it.
1846    if (size != notSet) return;
1847    // But short circuit buffer size is normally not set. Put in place the hbase wanted size.
1848    int hbaseSize = conf.getInt("hbase." + dfsKey, defaultSize);
1849    conf.setIfUnset(dfsKey, Integer.toString(hbaseSize));
1850  }
1851
1852  /**
1853   * Returns The DFSClient DFSHedgedReadMetrics instance or null if can't be found or not on hdfs.
1854   */
1855  public static DFSHedgedReadMetrics getDFSHedgedReadMetrics(final Configuration c)
1856    throws IOException {
1857    if (!CommonFSUtils.isHDFS(c)) {
1858      return null;
1859    }
1860    // getHedgedReadMetrics is package private. Get the DFSClient instance that is internal
1861    // to the DFS FS instance and make the method getHedgedReadMetrics accessible, then invoke it
1862    // to get the singleton instance of DFSHedgedReadMetrics shared by DFSClients.
1863    final String name = "getHedgedReadMetrics";
1864    DFSClient dfsclient = ((DistributedFileSystem) FileSystem.get(c)).getClient();
1865    Method m;
1866    try {
1867      m = dfsclient.getClass().getDeclaredMethod(name);
1868    } catch (NoSuchMethodException e) {
1869      LOG.warn(
1870        "Failed find method " + name + " in dfsclient; no hedged read metrics: " + e.getMessage());
1871      return null;
1872    } catch (SecurityException e) {
1873      LOG.warn(
1874        "Failed find method " + name + " in dfsclient; no hedged read metrics: " + e.getMessage());
1875      return null;
1876    }
1877    m.setAccessible(true);
1878    try {
1879      return (DFSHedgedReadMetrics) m.invoke(dfsclient);
1880    } catch (IllegalAccessException | IllegalArgumentException | InvocationTargetException e) {
1881      LOG.warn("Failed invoking method " + name + " on dfsclient; no hedged read metrics: "
1882        + e.getMessage());
1883      return null;
1884    }
1885  }

1887  public static List<Path> copyFilesParallel(FileSystem srcFS, Path src, FileSystem dstFS, Path dst,
1888    Configuration conf, int threads) throws IOException {
1889    ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(threads);
1890    List<Future<Void>> futures = new ArrayList<>();
1891    List<Path> traversedPaths;
1892    try {
1893      traversedPaths = copyFiles(srcFS, src, dstFS, dst, conf, pool, futures);
1894      for (Future<Void> future : futures) {
1895        future.get();
1896      }
1897    } catch (ExecutionException | InterruptedException | IOException e) {
1898      throw new IOException("Copy snapshot reference files failed", e);
1899    } finally {
1900      pool.shutdownNow();
1901    }
1902    return traversedPaths;
1903  }
1904
1905  private static List<Path> copyFiles(FileSystem srcFS, Path src, FileSystem dstFS, Path dst,
1906    Configuration conf, ExecutorService pool, List<Future<Void>> futures) throws IOException {
1907    List<Path> traversedPaths = new ArrayList<>();
1908    traversedPaths.add(dst);
1909    FileStatus currentFileStatus = srcFS.getFileStatus(src);
1910    if (currentFileStatus.isDirectory()) {
1911      if (!dstFS.mkdirs(dst)) {
1912        throw new IOException("Create directory failed: " + dst);
1913      }
1914      FileStatus[] subPaths = srcFS.listStatus(src);
1915      for (FileStatus subPath : subPaths) {
1916        traversedPaths.addAll(copyFiles(srcFS, subPath.getPath(), dstFS,
1917          new Path(dst, subPath.getPath().getName()), conf, pool, futures));
1918      }
1919    } else {
1920      Future<Void> future = pool.submit(() -> {
1921        FileUtil.copy(srcFS, src, dstFS, dst, false, false, conf);
1922        return null;
1923      });
1924      futures.add(future);
1925    }
1926    return traversedPaths;
1927  }

1929  /** Returns A set containing all namenode addresses of fs */
1930  private static Set<InetSocketAddress> getNNAddresses(DistributedFileSystem fs,
1931    Configuration conf) {
1932    Set<InetSocketAddress> addresses = new HashSet<>();
1933    String serviceName = fs.getCanonicalServiceName();
1934
1935    if (serviceName.startsWith("ha-hdfs")) {
1936      try {
1937        Map<String, Map<String, InetSocketAddress>> addressMap =
1938          DFSUtil.getNNServiceRpcAddressesForCluster(conf);
1939        String nameService = serviceName.substring(serviceName.indexOf(":") + 1);
1940        if (addressMap.containsKey(nameService)) {
1941          Map<String, InetSocketAddress> nnMap = addressMap.get(nameService);
1942          for (Map.Entry<String, InetSocketAddress> e2 : nnMap.entrySet()) {
1943            InetSocketAddress addr = e2.getValue();
1944            addresses.add(addr);
1945          }
1946        }
1947      } catch (Exception e) {
1948        LOG.warn("DFSUtil.getNNServiceRpcAddresses failed. serviceName=" + serviceName, e);
1949      }
1950    } else {
1951      URI uri = fs.getUri();
1952      int port = uri.getPort();
1953      if (port < 0) {
1954        int idx = serviceName.indexOf(':');
1955        port = Integer.parseInt(serviceName.substring(idx + 1));
1956      }
1957      InetSocketAddress addr = new InetSocketAddress(uri.getHost(), port);
1958      addresses.add(addr);
1959    }
1960
1961    return addresses;
1962  }
1963
1964  /**
1965   * @param conf the Configuration of HBase
1966   * @return Whether srcFs and desFs are on same hdfs or not
1967   */
1968  public static boolean isSameHdfs(Configuration conf, FileSystem srcFs, FileSystem desFs) {
1969    // By getCanonicalServiceName, we could make sure both srcFs and desFs
1970    // show a unified format which contains scheme, host and port.
1971    String srcServiceName = srcFs.getCanonicalServiceName();
1972    String desServiceName = desFs.getCanonicalServiceName();
1973
1974    if (srcServiceName == null || desServiceName == null) {
1975      return false;
1976    }
1977    if (srcServiceName.equals(desServiceName)) {
1978      return true;
1979    }
1980    if (srcServiceName.startsWith("ha-hdfs") && desServiceName.startsWith("ha-hdfs")) {
1981      Collection<String> internalNameServices =
1982        conf.getTrimmedStringCollection("dfs.internal.nameservices");
1983      if (!internalNameServices.isEmpty()) {
1984        if (internalNameServices.contains(srcServiceName.split(":")[1])) {
1985          return true;
1986        } else {
1987          return false;
1988        }
1989      }
1990    }
1991    if (srcFs instanceof DistributedFileSystem && desFs instanceof DistributedFileSystem) {
1992      // If one serviceName is an HA format while the other is a non-HA format,
1993      // maybe they refer to the same FileSystem.
1994      // For example, srcFs is "ha-hdfs://nameservices" and desFs is "hdfs://activeNamenode:port"
1995      Set<InetSocketAddress> srcAddrs = getNNAddresses((DistributedFileSystem) srcFs, conf);
1996      Set<InetSocketAddress> desAddrs = getNNAddresses((DistributedFileSystem) desFs, conf);
1997      if (Sets.intersection(srcAddrs, desAddrs).size() > 0) {
1998        return true;
1999      }
2000    }
2001
2002    return false;
2003  }
2004}
